description:
About Space Mission Design Game challenge:

Our goal is to build an engaging, intuitive, and educational game/simulation where players balance real-world mission trade-offs — budget, payload mass, power, orbits, and science instruments — to launch and sustain a successful space mission.
summary:
Game is an integrated flight operations and systems engineering simulator built for modern web browsers. Designed from the perspective of a NASA Mission Director (CMD), the game challenges players to lead a multidisciplinary crew — Scientist, Flight Engineer, and Navigator — across the full lifecycle of real-world Earth Venture orbital campaigns like "Eye of the Cyclone".

Rather than isolating mechanics into abstract math, the game models realistic multidisciplinary trade-offs: scientific observation accuracy vs. sensor mass, electrical power margins, satellite bus sizing, and launch vehicle delta-V trajectories (SpaceX Falcon 9 vs. Rocket Lab Electron).

By bridging theoretical astrophysics with commercial aerospace engineering and real-time decision-making, the project makes complex space mission architecture intuitive, consequential, and educational.
details:
1. What It Does & How It Works

Space Mission Design Game is an integrated flight operations simulator that models the complete systems engineering lifecycle of a scientific space mission. Players take the command seat as the NASA Mission Director (CMD) in a modern Mission Control Center interface.

The gameplay follows an authentic multi-stage commissioning pipeline:

  • Campaign Selection: Choosing real Earth Venture orbital missions (such as Eye of the Cyclone, focused on tropical hurricane intensification).
  • Scientist Directives (SCI): Issuing payload requirements (e.g., Maximum Sounding Precision vs. Ultra-Compact Form Factor), triggering real-time simulation latency.
  • Alerts & Equipment Procurement: Reviewing telemetry, power draw, dry mass, and budget impact before approving scientific hardware (e.g., NASA JPL RainCube Ka-Band Precipitation Radar).
  • Automated Cascade to Flight Engineer (ENG): Dynamic sizing of the spacecraft bus (solar array generation, battery capacity, 3-axis stabilization) matching the payload requirements.
  • Navigator Orbital Matching (NAV): Calculating delta-V budgets for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) insertion and contracting commercial launch vehicles (SpaceX Falcon 9 rideshare vs. Rocket Lab Electron dedicated).
  • 100% Commissioning & Flight Readiness Review (FRR): Validating all subsystems to achieve full launch pad staging.

2. Benefits & Intended Impact

  • Demystifying Aerospace Trade-Offs: Demonstrates how changing a single payload sensor causes cascading physical constraints across the entire spacecraft bus, electrical budget, and launch vehicle.
  • Bridging Science and Engineering: Connects theoretical atmospheric science with practical commercial spaceflight solutions.
  • Educational & Engaging: Provides an intuitive, hands-on flight controller experience suitable for university students, educators, and space enthusiasts alike.

3. Tools, Technologies, and Software Used

  • Frontend Core: React 19, TypeScript, Vite.
  • Styling & Design System: Tailwind CSS v4, custom NASA flight console typography and retro-futuristic telemetry themes.
  • Simulation Logic & State Management: Deterministic aerospace trade-off state machine modeling real physics (Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, solar power vs. eclipse thermal cycles, link budgets).
  • Automation & Quality Assurance: Puppeteer automated flight regression suite for multi-stage verification and screenshot generation.
  • Presentation Layer: Dedicated single-file HTML presentation engine (vite-plugin-singlefile) bundling interactive slides, embedded base64 assets, and bilingual support (EN/RU).

4. Creativity & Key Factors Considered

  • Crew Specialization & Role Dynamics: Rather than micro-managing formulas, the player commands an intelligent multidisciplinary crew (CMD, SCI, NAV, ENG) via radio net and alerts, mimicking real NASA operations.
  • Authentic Pedigree: Incorporates actual NASA mission parameters, certified aerospace vendors (SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Blue Canyon Technologies), and realistic USD budgeting.
  • Zero-Barrier Accessibility: Runs natively in any modern web browser without installations, with support for offline single-file deployment.
